build_optical_flow_deployment: build a Ray Serve deployment that calculates optical flow and motion scores for video frames
run_optical_flow_endpoint: run a POST request to the optical flow endpoint with a video file path and sampling parameters
calculate_motion_metrics: calculate motion scores and optical flow vectors from video frames using Farneback algorithm
create_torchcodec_video_dataset: create a TorchCodecVideoDataset with configurable start, end, stride, and sampling rate for video processing
configure_optical_flow_batch_size: configure the optical flow deployment with custom torch batch size and return flow options
